historical_series.anti_leakage: For each target, model inputs and fitted quantities may use only election outcomes at or before the stated origin year.

party_identity_policy.PJD_1997: Constitutional and Democratic Popular Movement is mapped prospectively to the PJD lineage.
party_identity_policy.PPS_1997: Party of Renewal and Progress led by Ismail Alaoui is mapped to the PPS lineage.
party_identity_policy.OTHER: All parties outside the eight named buckets, including independents, mergers, entrants and exits not explicitly crosswalked, remain in OTHER.
party_identity_policy.historical_zero_policy: Zeros are retained during scoring and are allowed to incur entrant error.

common_transformation.raw_output: Each model emits one nine-component real vector.
common_transformation.simplex_projection: Deterministic Euclidean projection onto the non-negative unit simplex using the standard sorted-threshold algorithm.
common_transformation.prospective_only: After winner refit for 2026, apply the fixed 1e-8 floor and renormalize only to satisfy the downstream strictly-positive contract.

POOLED_SHRUNK_NATIONAL_SWING.formula: Let Delta_i=p_i-p_(i-1) for all consecutive elections ending at or before origin. With k prior transitions and mu=mean_i(Delta_i), p_hat_t=ProjectSimplex(p_origin + [k/(k+1)]*mu). If k=0, use persistence.
POOLED_SHRUNK_NATIONAL_SWING.shrinkage_interpretation: One zero-swing pseudo-transition, shared across all parties.

PARTY_SHRUNK_NATIONAL_SWING.formula: With k prior transitions, mu_j=mean_i(Delta_ij), q=mean_(i,j)(Delta_ij^2), and r_j=(k*mu_j^2)/(k*mu_j^2+q) when q>0, p_hat_t=ProjectSimplex(p_origin + r elementwise mu). If k=0 or q=0, use persistence.
PARTY_SHRUNK_NATIONAL_SWING.shrinkage_interpretation: Party components with weak historical directional signal relative to pooled swing energy are shrunk more strongly.

SHRUNK_MEAN_REVERSION.formula: For each eligible historical transition with at least two elections available at its origin, d_i=mean(shares through origin_i)-p_origin_i and Delta_i=p_target_i-p_origin_i. Estimate beta=clip([sum_i d_i dot Delta_i]/[2*sum_i d_i dot d_i],0,1). For the current origin, d=mean(shares through origin)-p_origin and p_hat_t=ProjectSimplex(p_origin+beta*d). If no eligible transition or zero denominator, beta=0.
SHRUNK_MEAN_REVERSION.shrinkage_interpretation: Non-negative mean-reversion coefficient with a ridge penalty equal to the observed predictor energy, halving the unregularized pooled coefficient.

selection.primary: Equal-weight mean across scored folds of RMSE over the nine party-share buckets.
selection.tertiary: Worst-fold RMSE, then top-party accuracy, then fixed model order as deterministic final tie-break.
